text:
Tara: Heads up — found a split invoice from Marketplace partner PXR where platform fees and committed Dedicated usage are on the same invoice. Need to confirm rev rec approach before close tomorrow.
Kevin: Can you paste the invoice lines? I think there are two logical lines but same doc number.
Tara: Paste below (scraped):
`INV-90712, PXR, platform_fee, 12345.00, USD`
`INV-90712, PXR, dedicated_usage, 45000.00, USD`
Our usual flow is platform fees -> marketplace revenue (or contra) and dedicated_usage -> hosted revenue. If they're on the same invoice do we split by line for recognition or treat as one composite sale? Month-end is tomorrow.
Alex: Split by line is correct operationally — GL mapping drives revenue buckets. Platform_fee should map to 4600-marketplace_rev (or deferred if prepaid), dedicated_usage to 4100-hosted_rev. If platform_fee is service with future performance, it may need deferral/amortization.
Priya: Also check currency mapping — customer billing entity sometimes posts in EUR and we book USD. FX reval could change the numbers. I'll pull the invoice export. @billing-bot can you grab INV-90712 detail?
billing-bot: Export complete — INV-90712 lines uploaded to s3://redwood-finance-extracts/INV-90712.csv
Kevin: OK. For month-end close proposal: create two JEs — one to move platform_fee A/R balance to a marketplace-clearing A/R (so revenue mapping is clean), then recognize hosted usage to hosted_rev. If deferral needed, book to deferred_rev with an amort schedule. Will draft JE and memo. Who signs off on reclass?
Tara: I can draft the memo + attach CSV and GL impact calc. Need approval by 17:00 PT today to include in close. If no sign-off, fallback is to book full amount to hosted_rev with explanatory note and correct next period.
Alex: I'll prepare the rev schedule impact and an amortization table for the platform_fee (if we defer) — ETA 14:00 today.
Priya: I'll run the FX revaluation after you post the JEs and add numbers to the memo. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Adding callout — if partner has a marketplace commission payable, we'll need to book a contra or COGS line. Tara, include vendor commission status in the memo so we can determine net vs gross presentation.
Tara: Will do. Drafting now, ping me if you want to review before I send to Maya for approval. :thinking:
